integrity: The theorem is proved algebraically from published sector secular determinants. The supplied computation checks identities and representative roots only and is corroborative, not a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the unit-edge equilateral octahedron with the cyclic preferred-orientation coupling and positive spectrum; it does not treat unequal edge lengths, phase-distorted couplings, or negative eigenvalues.
title: Exact scalar factorization and triple degeneracy in the preferred-orientation octahedron spectrum
